newsitem.title: USA: Colonel's founder's wife named chairwoman.
newsitem.headline: Colonel's founder's wife named chairwoman.

text.p: The Colonel's International Inc said Thursday that Patsy Williamson was elected to replace her husband, Donald Williamson, as chairman of the board.
Donald Williamson, founder of the car and truck equipment company, is retiring from active involvment with the company, it said. He will continue as a senior spokesman and adviser for the company.
Patsy Williamson is president of Patsy L. Williamson Buick-GMC Inc and related automobile dealerships.
